text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each cell is one pair of penalties on the tuning units (Solar farms A and B). a is the weight on weekly capacity changes and r is the factor by which a fall costs more than a rise. F marks the frozen pair (a=4, r=30) and P the post hoc pair (a=2, r=10), which was picked after the scoring run. Green: the tuning limit is met (at most 0.5 constant-path false steps per Primary-year; at least 0.5 of a 26-week fall recovered). The path error has no limit.'
